blocks.html: FATHER’S DAY FAST BREAK AT ROBINSONS MALLS
Looking for the best Father’s Day treat? Go and visit Robinsons Malls and find out what's in store, making June 21 an exciting and memorable Father’s Day celebration.

Participating Robinsons Malls (Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Otis, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, and Robinsons Place Lipa) have rounded up fun activities for every basketball fanatic dad.

To join the activities, register on June 21, 10 am -12 noon by presenting a minimum single-receipt purchase (except services) of P500 from June 15-21 in exchange of an event pass. The event pass will entitle the father and his child to score some points in the basketball shootout; strike their best father-and-son or father-and-daughter pose at the photobooth; do their best moves in the event’s various games; and win exclusive PBA merchandise.

Another reason to look forward to Robinsons Malls’ Father’s Day Fast Break is the PBA Players Meet and Greet. Get the chance to be up close and personal with your favorite PBA basketball stars Terrence Romeo, Kwame Alexander and Doug Kramer at Robinsons Galleria and Forum Robinsons; Mac Baracael, Larry Rodriguez and Rob Labagala at Robinsons Otis and Robinsons Place Manila; Anthony Semerad, Stanley Pringle and Sunday Salvacion at Robinsons Metro East and Robinsons Place Antipolo; Keith Jensen, KG Canaleta and LA Revilla at Robinsons Novaliches; Mac Cardona, Jens Knuttel and Alex Nuyles at Robinsons Place Las Piñas; and Emman Monfort, Paul Artadi and Rich Alvarez at Robinsons Sta. Rosa.

For more details, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or download the Robinsons App for details. Also, follow and like Robinsons Malls Facebook page (www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls), Twitter (www.twitter.com/RobinsonsMalls), and instagram (@RobinsonsMallsOfficial).
